design: Single observation per exact input; exploratory screen only.
interpretation: All planned candidates are included. Differences may reflect detector variability; repeat matched baseline/candidate controls before attributing effects to edits. Rationale and preservation notes do not certify fidelity, readability, or tone.
pangram_scores: Row-level Pangram results (document fractions, window scores, labels and spans, and the per-text values and outcomes derived from them) are kept privately and not published. Text hashes, request ids and record paths identify each observation for verification.
